RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

This Lease is made at Bengaluru, Karnataka between Mr. Ramesh Gowda (the Owner) and Ms. Ananya Rao, Aadhaar 4821 7734 9012, phone +91 98450 12345, email ananya.rao@example.com (the Tenant).

1. Term of Lease. The lease shall be for a period of eleven (11) months commencing on the date of execution.

2. Notice Period. The Tenant shall provide three months written notice prior to vacating the premises.

3. Security Deposit. The Tenant shall pay an interest-free security deposit of Rs. 2,00,000, equal to ten months rent. The security deposit shall be refunded after deduction of dues and damages, if any.

4. Maintenance. The Tenant shall keep the premises in good condition, subject to normal wear and tear.

7. Exit Charges. The Tenant shall pay a painting charge of Rs. 40,000 at the time of vacating the premises.

8. Jurisdiction. Courts at Bengaluru shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
